Once Git recognizes the repo, the practical workflow is:

```powershell
entire status                    # Is Entire enabled and healthy?
entire activity                  # Overview of tracked work
entire recap                     # Summary of recent agent work
entire search "authentication"   # Find related sessions/checkpoints
entire checkpoint list           # Checkpoints on this branch
entire checkpoint explain <id>   # Inspect what an agent did
```

For this repo, the key idea is: every normal Git commit automatically captures the AI session as an Entire checkpoint. So just work and commit normally; there’s no need to create manual checkpoints unless you specifically want one.
